claims.text:
The meaning of the name Gormadoc is unknown. J.R.R. Tolkien noted that the names of the Bucklanders had a vaguely Celtic style.
Jim Allan suggests that it contains the element gor, which means "over" in Welsh as a prefix to Madoc, the first name of Gormadoc Brandybuck's son.
